summary:
Resolution 1: Shareholders adopted the Directors' Statement and audited financial statements for FY2025 together with the independent auditor's report (75.60% for, carried).
Resolution 2: Shareholders re-elected Mr Niu Liming as a Director of the Company (73.83% for, carried).
Resolution 3: Shareholders re-elected Mr Er Kwong Wah as a Director of the Company (99.83% for, carried).
Resolution 4: Shareholders re-elected Ms Ng Chern Nee as a Director of the Company (73.83% for, carried).
Resolution 5: Shareholders re-elected Mr Wan Tai Foong as a Director of the Company (99.87% for, carried).
Resolution 6: Shareholders approved the payment of Directors' fees of S$204,000 for FY2026 (99.83% for, carried).
Resolution 7: Shareholders re-appointed Nexia Singapore PAC as the Company's auditor (60.61% for, carried).
